Serbia Formally Drops ‘Violent Overthrow’ Case Against Student Protesters

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Serbia has formally dropped the 'violent overthrow' case against student protesters. [5]
Serbia's student movement has criticised the European Parliament's Vukovar Resolution. [2]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market related to Serbia, "Will Radomir Saičić win the next Serbia presidential election?", priced Yes at 81% on Nov 24, 2026; it closes May 2, 2027. [E4]

WATCH ITEMS
Whether Serbia's student movement will continue its protests against the secret services and organised crime. [3]
Whether Radomir Saičić will win the next Serbia presidential election as the Polymarket market closes on May 2, 2027. [E4]
